component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.assets.watermark.videos
component.documentation:
Since 0.6.0, a video a rights policy's watermark marks: short, marked in the request, as before; long, over nuxeo.agentic.watermark.video.background.bytes bytes or, read by ffprobe, nuxeo.agentic.watermark.video.background.seconds seconds, marked by a job in the work manager's queue agenticVideoWatermark, while Asset.GetWatermarked answers 202, preparing, and a delivery is refused, watermark-pending, to be filed again once it is ready.
The marked copy is kept as a WatermarkedCopy, under a key naming the document, its file's place and digest, the policy's watermark, why it was marked, the text drawn, and the person and the territory where the text names them: so it is reused for that key alone, never served to anyone else, and dropped when the file or the watermark changes, or once it is nuxeo.agentic.watermark.video.copy.days days old. One job per key at a time across the cluster: each holds the key's lease in the key/value store agenticWatermarks while it runs. A failure is kept there, audited on the document, assetWatermarkFailed, and answered with its reason for nuxeo.agentic.watermark.video.failure.minutes minutes. The unmarked video is never served, while it is being marked or after it fails.
